# spc-hpra (PHAROS fixture)

HPRA "Find a medicine", saved 7 November 2026.

* `search_ivabradine.json`: the answer of the search behind
  `https://www.hpra.ie/find-a-medicine/for-human-use/authorised-medicines` for "ivabradine" (14 products, ten of
  them centrally authorised, `emaUrl`).

The search page itself is not saved: it carries the key of HPRA's search address. The tests use a one-line page
with a made-up key instead.
